retrievalProfile.description: A classic jazz-inspired layout featuring a central profile portrait with a glowing aura, framed by repeating border text and a circular graphic seal.

recipe.visualDefinition: A square composition centered on a profile portrait of a child looking upward, set against a blue halftone grid. The image is framed by a thick white border containing repeating italicized script text. A circular, textured gold seal is positioned in the upper right quadrant.
coreVisualRelationships: Central subject framed by a high-contrast white border
Circular seal balancing the upward gaze of the subject
Repeating text creating a rhythmic frame
Halftone texture contrasting with smooth photographic skin tones
coreInvariants: Blue textured background with visible halftone or canvas pattern
Subject in profile looking toward the upper right

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large-scale profile portrait occupying the lower-left and center, looking toward the upper-right corner.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The child's face and the circular gold seal in the upper right.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the subject's upward gaze from the bottom left toward the circular seal in the top right, then circles the border text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The blue halftone background serves as active negative space, textured to prevent flatness.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep blue background with halftone texture.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright white for the outer border and text background.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Golden yellow for the circular seal and patterned clothing.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High contrast between the dark silhouette of the hair and the bright white border.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavyweight, slanted brush script with high contrast.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Lowercase letters are compact and fluid

composition.position: Inside the white border on all four sides

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A heavy script for the border paired with a custom-lettered circular seal for internal branding.
graphicDevices: Circular seal with warped internal text
Corner icons (musical notes) in blue squares

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, slanted, calligraphic feel of the border text.
Provides a similar weight and vintage feel if a script is not desired.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a profile portrait of a subject looking up, with a soft blue glow around the head, set against a blue halftone canvas background. Include a circular gold textured seal in the top right.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a thick white border around the image. Place repeating bold italic script text inside the border on all four sides, rotating the text to follow the frame's orientation.

verificationChecks: Is the text repeated on all four sides of the border?
Is the subject looking toward the upper right?
Is the background textured with a halftone pattern?
Is the circular seal present in the upper right quadrant?

mustRedesign: Exact text within the circular seal

mustAchieve: Balanced framing with the white border

postGenerationChecks: Check that the border text is correctly rotated on the sides.
Ensure the blue glow around the subject is soft and integrated.
Verify the halftone pattern is visible but not distracting.
Confirm the circular seal has a distressed, metallic texture.
recipe.reuseFormula: Profile Portrait + Halftone Background + Repeating Script Border + Circular Graphic Seal = Jazz Revival Aesthetic
